recommendations.description: Require a targeted AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION auth-to-claim and claims-processing audit for Commercial Local Group inpatient claims in CA, VA, NY, and OH; reprocess misclassified PA-required claims and verify authorization denial enforcement for Stanford Hospital, HENRICO DOCTORS' HOSPITAL, OHIO STATE UNIVERSITY WEXNER MEDICAL CENTER, THE CLEVELAND CLINIC MAIN CAMPUS, and impacted DRGs including Ungroupable, Cervical Spinal Fusion with CC, and Postpartum and Postabortion Diagnoses without O.R. Procedures.
evidence: Pattern flagged auth_or_mapping_shift and requires_validation_before_action.
AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION impacts Commercial Local Group inpatient claims across CA, VA, NY, and OH.
CA affected DRGs include Ungroupable, Cervical Spinal Fusion with CC, and postpartum claims.
VA issue is concentrated at HENRICO DOCTORS' HOSPITAL.
OH and NY issues include OHIO STATE and CLEVELAND CLINIC providers.

recommendations.description: Initiate a Yale New Haven Hospital-specific CT Commercial Local Group PPO acute inpatient policy review across authorization-required and non-authorization stays to confirm prior authorization when required, reconcile auth-to-claim matches, enforce authorization denial processing, assess initial and concurrent acute review KPIs, and validate reimbursement against contractual payment terms.
evidence: Yale New Haven Hospital concentrates CT PPO acute inpatient spend growth.
Authorization-required CT PPO acute claims added about $4.2M with higher admissions and paid/admit.
Non-authorization CT PPO acute claims added about $1.1M with higher admissions and paid/admit.
Pattern flags include auth_dimension_present and repeated_delta_concentration.
peer_benchmarking: United Health bundles inpatient and outpatient facility settings.
Cigna policy scope is professional claims only, not inpatient facility payment rules.
Point32Health observation policy applies at contracted acute care hospitals.
Emblem Health has no DRG-specific acute inpatient site-of-service policy identified.

recommendations.description: Implement a provider-specific OH PPO acute IP Med/Surg review for THE CLEVELAND CLINIC MAIN CAMPUS and OHIO STATE UNIVERSITY WEXNER MEDICAL CENTER to verify prior authorization, enforce denial edits, validate contract-based claim payment, and assess site-of-care or admission management for Medical Back Problems without MCC.
evidence: Cleveland Clinic added about +$2.3M on 47 more admissions; paid per admit fell.
Ohio State added about +$1.7M on 22 more admissions; paid per admit rose.
Medical Back Problems without MCC added about +$0.2M on 8 more admissions.
Both provider cards have pa_required_code Y and auth-to-claim validation business terms.
peer_benchmarking: Cigna broadly bundles routine room, board, nursing, supplies, and many ancillaries into facility payment.
United Health bundles routine services, ancillary components, supplies, and equipment into facility reimbursement.

recommendations.description: Initiate a CA Commercial Local Group acute inpatient policy audit that reviews UM KPI changes and admission root causes for PPO Postpartum and Postabortion Diagnoses without O.R. Procedures and Medical Back Problems without MCC, and validates PA-to-claim matching, denial enforcement, contractual processing, itemized bills, and step-down discharge planning for PPO Ungroupable, PPO Cervical Spinal Fusion with CC, and HMO Aftercare with CC/MCC.
evidence: CA PPO acute mixed pressure was led by Ungroupable and cervical spinal fusion.
PPO postpartum and back increases were mostly volume-led.
HMO Aftercare with CC/MCC rose from much higher paid per admit.
PPO acute cards show PA-required claims; HMO aftercare shows non-PA claims.
peer_benchmarking: Cigna bundles global maternity care and restricts CPT 59430 to postpartum-only care.

recommendations.description: Launch a claim-level contract compliance and itemized-bill audit for CA IP Med/Surg ungroupable admissions at Stanford Hospital and targeted review of Cervical Spinal Fusion with CC and Acute and Subacute Endocarditis with MCC cases at Los Angeles General Medical Center and Lucile Packard Childrens Hospital Stanford to confirm DRG grouping, reimbursement methodology, final adjudication, and any stop-loss or special payment provisions.
evidence: Two ungroupable CA IP Med/Surg cases added about $5.3M.
Ungroupable claims were at Stanford Hospital and coded PA required Y.
Cervical Spinal Fusion with CC increased at Los Angeles General Medical Center.
Endocarditis outlier occurred at Lucile Packard Childrens Hospital Stanford.
peer_benchmarking: Cigna requires documentation confirming at least 50% vertebral body resection for separate reimbursement.

recommendations.description: Audit prior-auth-to-claim matching, level-of-care approvals, and contractual payment for Commercial Local Group LTCH and Physical Rehab admissions in GA, VA, and WI, starting with GA POS LTCH Ungroupable, VA POS/PPO LTCH, and WI POS Physical Rehab Aftercare with CC/MCC; require itemized bill review on outlier claims.
evidence: GA POS LTCH Ungroupable had no admission growth and sharply higher paid per admit.
VA POS LTCH Aftercare with CC/MCC added six admissions with high paid per admit.
VA PPO LTCH added two admissions from a small baseline.
WI POS Physical Rehab Aftercare with CC/MCC added four admissions from zero baseline.
Pattern recommends reviewing authorization criteria, level-of-care decisions, and contract terms.
peer_benchmarking: Cigna: pattern not mentioned; no appeals process documented.

recommendations.description: Conduct claim re-adjudication and itemized bill review for YALE NEW HAVEN HOSPITAL and THE CLEVELAND CLINIC MAIN CAMPUS IP Med/Surg admissions under Tracheostomy with Mechanical Ventilation >96 Hours or Principal Diagnosis Except Face, Mouth and Neck without Major O.R. Procedures tied to SEPSIS UNSPECIFIED ORGANISM, ACUTE CHRONIC RESP FAIL W/HYPOXIA, and LUNG TRANSPLANT INFECTION, verifying contractual DRG payment, diagnosis coding, and prior-authorization enforcement.
evidence: All deltas roll to the same tracheostomy/prolonged ventilation DRG.
YALE NEW HAVEN HOSPITAL drove tracheostomy cases with sepsis and respiratory failure.
THE CLEVELAND CLINIC MAIN CAMPUS had a lung transplant infection case.
PA required code is Y across the cited admissions.
peer_benchmarking: Cigna bundles routine room, nursing, and supplies within inpatient facility DRGs.
United Health does not separately pay routine tracheostomy, respiratory, nursing, and supply components.
Elevance Health relies on standard coding and regulatory requirements for inpatient DRG processing.
